links.comparator_used: Accuracy on all predictions (no exclusion of uncertain predictions), simulating a human-in-the-loop strategy
links.outcome: Discharge destination prediction accuracy after excluding the 15% of predictions with highest uncertainty
links.effect: Accuracy rose from 82% overall to 85% for the remaining predictions (p = 0.006)
links.tradeoff: 15% of predictions were excluded and would need human review; the human-in-the-loop strategy was only mimicked, not actually tested.
links.quote: Mimicking a human-in-the-loop strategy, we excluded the 15% of predictions with the highest uncertainty, which increased accuracy for the remaining predictions to 85% (p = 0.006).
